bio.text: Chris Stigall, a radio talk show host, won the Republican nomination for Missouri's 6th Congressional District in the August 2026 primary.
KCTV describes him as a former Kansas City talk show personality and nationally syndicated host.
He has not held elected office before, according to KCUR, and faces Democrat Josh Smead and Libertarian Andy Maidment in the November general election for the seat Sam Graves is leaving.

sources.title: Talk show host Chris Stigall wins GOP nomination, will face Democrat challenger Josh Smead
